mainEntity.name: Is it better to build an attached or detached guest suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: An attached suite connects directly to the main residence, making it less expensive to heat, cool, and plumb by tapping into existing home systems. It also allows easier indoor access, which is ideal when caring for aging family members. A detached suite provides superior acoustic privacy and independence for guests, but requires trenching utilities across the yard, pouring an independent foundation, and handling separate exterior finishes like roofing and stucco. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms evaluates your lot dimensions and utility connection points to help you choose the best fit.
acceptedAnswer.description: Attached suites share existing home utilities and offer easier caregiving access, while detached suites offer maximum privacy but typically require higher site and utility costs.
